docs.intro: The product already has a working SaaS skeleton. What remains are mostly the commercial and operational layers needed to make it feel complete for paying teams.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Vidat processes account data, website metadata, and scan results to deliver monitoring and reporting.
privacy.item1: We store user identifiers, plan status, and created resources.
privacy.item2: Scan results, reports, and issues are stored to provide history in the product.
privacy.item3: Personal data is limited to what is required for authentication, billing, support, and operations.
privacy.item4: To delete account or support data, an administrative deletion routine must be connected on the backend.
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms are a product baseline and must be completed with legally approved language before public launch.
terms.item1: The service is provided as-is and may be used to monitor owned or approved websites.
terms.item2: Paid plans govern available features, limits, and support levels.
terms.item3: Abuse, unauthorized scanning, or attempts to bypass account limits may result in suspension.
terms.item4: Customer data should be exported or deleted according to documented retention when a subscription ends.

home.hero.pill: Catch regressions before your customers do
home.hero.title: Make performance a product, not an afterthought.
home.hero.description: Vidat gives product teams and agencies a clear view of how every release affects speed, SEO, and user experience. Track Lighthouse over time, catch regressions early, and turn technical signals into actions the whole team can understand.
home.metrics.m1: Monitor sites, reports, and score changes.
home.metrics.m2: Plans from free tier to enterprise.
home.metrics.m3: Dashboard, reports, webhooks, and account controls — in one place.
home.demo.title: Deploy health
home.demo.alertDescription: LCP degraded by 380ms after the latest mobile deploy. The analytics bundle grew significantly.
home.demo.aiDescription: Move third-party scripts off the critical render path, delay tag manager on mobile, and review the latest deploy for new above-the-fold image blocks.
home.productPillars.performance.title: Performance without manual work
home.productPillars.performance.descript: Scheduled Lighthouse runs, history, and regression tracking for every website.
home.productPillars.insights.title: Actionable insights
home.productPillars.insights.description: AI explanations, prioritized recommendations, and reports you can share with your team or customers.
home.productPillars.ops.title: Built for operations
home.productPillars.ops.description: Alerts, team workflows, and integrations that move issues from report to action without manual chasing.
home.sections.features.title: Everything you need to spot regressions before revenue, SEO, or trust takes a hit.
home.sections.features.description: Vidat combines monitoring, reporting, and alerts so teams can move from detection to decision without jumping between tools.
home.features.monitoring.title: Know the moment a release slows down your site.
home.features.monitoring.description: Automated scans reveal drops in performance, SEO, accessibility, and best practices before they turn into customer complaints or lost conversions.
home.features.monitoring.bullet1: Scheduled scans that keep watch without manual checks
home.features.monitoring.bullet2: Mobile and desktop visibility in one shared timeline
home.features.monitoring.bullet3: Historical trends that make regressions impossible to miss
home.features.reporting.title: Turn technical metrics into reports people actually act on.
home.features.reporting.description: Each report highlights what changed, what matters most, and where your team should focus next.
home.features.reporting.bullet1: Clear summaries for product, marketing, and development teams
home.features.reporting.bullet2: Prioritized findings instead of walls of raw Lighthouse data
home.features.reporting.bullet3: Client-friendly reporting for agencies and consultants
home.features.automation.title: Get alerted before customers notice the problem.
home.features.automation.description: Send critical events to the inboxes and systems your team already uses so regressions are handled while they are still small.
home.features.automation.bullet1: Email alerts for scan failures and major score drops
home.features.automation.bullet2: Webhook and Slack delivery for operational workflows
home.features.automation.bullet3: Flexible setup per workspace as your monitoring grows
home.sections.completeSaas.title: A monitoring workflow that fits both in-house teams and agencies.
home.sections.completeSaas.description: Vidat is designed for the people responsible for release quality, customer confidence, and visible results after every deploy.
home.completeSaas.billing.title: Plans that scale with your monitoring
home.completeSaas.billing.description: Start with a small footprint and expand to more sites, more stakeholders, and stricter operational needs as the work grows.
home.completeSaas.orgs.title: Shared workspaces for real teams
home.completeSaas.orgs.description: Keep websites, alerts, and reporting organized by workspace so product, marketing, and operations can work from the same source of truth.
home.completeSaas.onboarding.title: Fast time to value
home.completeSaas.onboarding.description: Add a site, run the first scan, and start seeing issues worth fixing in minutes instead of weeks.
home.completeSaas.trust.title: Built to earn trust
home.completeSaas.trust.description: Clear documentation, predictable alerts, and transparent operational signals make the product easier to buy and easier to rely on.
home.completeSaas.support.title: Support when the stakes are high
home.completeSaas.support.description: When a release hurts performance, your team needs a fast path from issue to response, not another dashboard to babysit.
home.completeSaas.gtm.title: Made for client-facing work
home.completeSaas.gtm.description: Agencies can turn technical monitoring into a repeatable, high-trust service with reporting that customers can follow.
home.sections.trust.title: Confidence matters as much as raw performance data.
home.sections.trust.description: Serious buyers want to know how you communicate, how you support them, and how quickly the team can react when something breaks.
home.trust.cards.ops.title: Reliable operations
home.trust.cards.ops.description: Operational visibility, dependable alerts, and a workflow that helps teams react quickly when quality drops.
home.trust.cards.policies.title: Clear policies
home.trust.cards.policies.description: Clear terms, transparent pricing, and trust pages that remove friction before a customer commits.
home.trust.cards.comms.title: Active communication
home.trust.cards.comms.description: Status communication, support paths, and notifications that make customers feel informed instead of exposed.
home.sections.pricing.title: Choose a plan that matches how many sites and stakeholders you manage.
home.sections.pricing.description: Start small, automate more as your release volume grows, and upgrade when monitoring becomes operationally critical.
home.pricing.free.name: Free
home.pricing.free.description: For trying Vidat on one site before you automate.
home.pricing.starter.name: Starter
home.pricing.starter.description: For smaller teams that want scheduled scans and early warning by email.
home.pricing.pro.name: Pro
home.pricing.pro.description: For teams with frequent releases and a real need for operational alerting.
home.pricing.enterprise.name: Enterprise
home.pricing.enterprise.description: For agencies and larger teams managing multiple sites, clients, and internal stakeholders.
home.sections.faq.title: Quick answers before you start monitoring your first site.
home.faq.q1.question: Who is Vidat for?
home.faq.q1.answer: Vidat is built for product teams, agencies, and consultants who need to keep websites fast, stable, and easy to explain to stakeholders.
home.faq.q2.question: What problems does it solve best?
home.faq.q2.answer: It is strongest when you need to catch performance regressions early, document what changed, and push alerts into the team's existing workflow.
home.faq.q3.question: Can it work for both internal teams and client work?
home.faq.q3.answer: Yes. Shared workspaces, customer-friendly reports, and alerting make it useful both for in-house monitoring and agency delivery.
home.nextSteps.title: Start monitoring before the next release creates a problem you only notice after the damage is done.
home.nextSteps.description: Create a workspace, add your first site, and let Vidat keep watch on the technical signals that affect traffic, conversions, and trust.
home.footer.tagline: Website monitoring for teams that want earlier warnings and clearer decisions.
